blockers.quote: And people don't like to admit envy, even to themselves (c12).
blockers.why: Claim c12's verbatim quote specifically states 'people do not like to admit being maliciously envious, neither to themselves nor to others (Foster 1972)', and the ledger note explicitly clarifies that 'The "admit" line is about malicious envy'. Stating that people don't like to admit 'envy' in general overstates the finding beyond what the source supports, especially since benign envy has different self-acknowledgment dynamics.
blockers.fix: And people don't like to admit being maliciously envious, even to themselves (c12).
